name: Booking page
job: A page where people book your time
intro: Booking page gives each person a link that offers only the times their calendars leave free. Every booking is checked again, lands on your calendar with a video link, and arrives with a brief.
does: Proposes your hours, call length and buffer from how you use your calendar.
Shows visitors times in their own zone, and confirms their email first.
Turns spam away politely, and has Meetings brief you on every real booking.

accounts.why: To check your busy times and add each booked call, with a Meet or Teams link.
Only to tell someone why their booking could not be taken.

setup: Choose which calendars your page keeps clear of.
Check the hours it proposes: days, call length, buffer and notice.
Pick your page's address and write a line about you.
Choose the video link and where bookings go, then turn the page on.
